phases.name: Run the auction trial
phases.label: Oct 14 – Nov 7
phases.milestone: Trial hammers and repriced controls judged against the success test.

phases.name: Roll out what worked
phases.label: Nov 8 – Nov 30
phases.milestone: Rollout batch submitted or a fixed-price plan confirmed.

phases.name: Price new arrivals
phases.label: As batches land, through Jan 5
phases.milestone: Every new card has a comp-based ask or a hold/grade call.

phases.name: Lot drafts ready
phases.label: Done Oct 14
phases.milestone: 75 drafts saved and checked against the plan.

phases.name: Go live
phases.label: Oct 15 – 19
phases.milestone: All 75 lots live at the planned prices.

phases.name: Ship and learn
phases.label: Oct 20 – Nov 8
phases.milestone: Three weeks of sales and pack-time data.

phases.name: Handle unsold lots
phases.label: Nov 9 onward
phases.milestone: A decision for every unsold lot, with your OK on any price change.

phases.name: Sort the football boxes
phases.label: Late Oct
phases.milestone: Rookie/parallel stacks, hits pile and team stacks separated.

phases.name: Price from comps
phases.label: Early Nov
phases.milestone: Every football lot and hit has a comp-based price that passes the guardrails.

phases.name: List and ship
phases.label: Mid Nov
phases.milestone: Football lots live and hits on their chosen channel.

tasks.title: Submit the 8-card auction trial
tasks.detail: Flagg X-Fractor, Crews Gold auto /50, De Paula, Donald, Sullivan, Loveland, Knueppel, Wemby copy 1. Store-credit payout.

tasks.title: Reprice the live cards to comp-based asks
tasks.detail: 29-card group plus the remaining 78, with six repriced controls for the trial.

tasks.title: Check 130point for Vince Carter /10 and Jeter /20
tasks.detail: Both prices rest on thin data. One manual search each before anyone buys at the current ask.

tasks.title: Decide on the Trinity Rodman 1/1
tasks.detail: Hold for the 2027 World Cup or auction now. The current ask is unsupported either way.

tasks.title: Log each trial hammer as it closes
tasks.detail: Record gross and net in the cash log; compare each to its market estimate.

tasks.title: Judge the trial against the success test
tasks.detail: Hammers at 70%+ of market? Wemby auction nets 75%+ of the fixed-price copy? Repriced cards sold within ~3 weeks?

tasks.title: Pick the rollout list
tasks.detail: From Ben Rice Purple /250, Willits auto, Wemby ROY Contenders, Flagg Holiday, the Kim/Mayo/Meidroth/Harvey/Wrobleski/Simpson autos, Joe Carter, Mahomes Impeccable and the small ones.

tasks.title: Decide on Ben Rice Purple /250
tasks.detail: Sell raw ~$230–310, auction, or grade for a long-shot PSA 10. Scenarios are in the Card Decision Log.

tasks.title: Check the November Marquee auction
tasks.detail: Needs $1,000+ of value; transfer deadline Nov 12. Only worth it if the rollout list is big enough.

tasks.title: Submit the rollout batch
tasks.detail: Submissions cannot be cancelled and list 1–2 weeks later.

tasks.title: Propose changes for repriced cards that have not sold
tasks.detail: Uses real sell-through; nothing changes without your OK.

tasks.title: Price each new batch as it lands
tasks.detail: Exact parallel first, freshness check on every comp, 5–20% patient premium.

tasks.title: Flag hold and grade candidates for your call
tasks.detail: Grade only if it clears $150–200 expected gain; show the scenarios when the spread is wide.

tasks.title: Approve asks and auction picks for each batch
tasks.detail: A quick review pass, not a re-pricing session.

tasks.title: Cash out store credit
tasks.detail: Fixed-price sales net 85.5% after the 10% cash-out. Log the payout.

tasks.title: Fill in the look-backs in the Card Decision Log
tasks.detail: Would the rejected option have paid more?

tasks.title: Agree a no-sale period and reprice stale asks
tasks.detail: Re-pricing uses sell-through data and needs your OK.

tasks.title: Build 75 lot drafts
tasks.detail: Category, Used, location 80214, photos, titles, checklists, ask and 75% Best Offer floor, item specifics.

tasks.title: Spot-check 4–5 drafts
tasks.detail: Look at photos, title and price on a few before listing.

tasks.title: Retake the two missing photos
tasks.detail: Celtics A page 9 front and Blue Jays C page 10 front.

tasks.title: Finish account settings and order supplies
tasks.detail: Item location, shipping policy, USPS account, mailers, chipboard, scale. Details in the eBay Lots Roadmap.

tasks.title: Sort NBA and MLB pages into lot stacks
tasks.detail: One stack per lot, labeled to match the draft titles.

tasks.title: Decide on Best Offer auto-accept
tasks.detail: Declines below 75% of ask happen either way.

tasks.title: List all 75 drafts
tasks.detail: From Manage drafts. Claude checks the live listings afterward.

tasks.title: Verify all 75 are live at the right prices
tasks.detail: Compare live listings to the plan.

tasks.title: Pack twice a week with scheduled USPS pickups
tasks.detail: Monday and Thursday pack nights; Tuesday and Friday pickups.

tasks.title: Time a few pack nights in the time log
tasks.detail: Decides whether the lots clear your ~$40/hr bar.

tasks.title: Log eBay payouts
tasks.detail: One cash-log entry per payout.

tasks.title: Pull sales and time-per-package data
tasks.detail: Sell-through by sport and lot size, net per lot, minutes per package.

tasks.title: Decide next steps for unsold lots
tasks.detail: Hold, relist, combine or adjust price. Any cut needs your OK.

tasks.title: Pull 2025 rookies and color parallels from the team boxes
tasks.detail: Into their own small lots of 25–50 cards, which get the best price per card.

tasks.title: Set aside the hits
tasks.detail: Autos, low-numbered parallels and star rookies get individual comps.

tasks.title: Page and photograph the rookie and parallel lots
tasks.detail: Fronts before backs, same naming as the other lots.

tasks.title: Comp the hits one by one
tasks.detail: Exact parallel first; label proxies.

tasks.title: Price the rookie and parallel lots
tasks.detail: Show both anchors: single-card comp total and upper-quartile sold-lot comps.

tasks.title: Price the remaining team lots and check the effort
tasks.detail: Large mixed lots sell for $0.07–0.30/card; skip any lot that fails the $40/hr test.

tasks.title: Choose a channel for the hits
tasks.detail: COMC (needs $50 processing minimum per submission), CardMaster consignment, or eBay.

tasks.title: Draft the football lots on eBay
tasks.detail: Same specifics, pricing guardrails and Best Offer floor as the other lots.

tasks.title: List and ship with the existing routine
tasks.detail: Fold football into the Monday/Thursday pack nights.

notes: Source of truth is the page database (39 tasks, 11 phases). Track keeps the page's three lanes (comc, ebay, football) instead of 'main'. Done: cs-01, cs-02, cs-18. Task 'who' (you/claude) not carried over; about half are Claude-owned (repricing, comping, drafting, proposals). Dollar figures for specific card asks removed from details. Likely overlaps with eBay Lots (eb): cs-18 build 75 drafts = eb-11..13 (done); cs-19 spot-check drafts = eb-15; cs-20 retake missing photos (Celtics p9 and Blue Jays C p10) = eb-10 (Celtics only); cs-21 settings+supplies = eb-01..07; cs-22 sort into stacks = eb-08/09; cs-23 Best Offer auto-accept = eb-14; cs-24 list all 75 = eb-17; cs-25 verify live = eb-18; cs-26 pack twice weekly = eb-19/20; cs-29 pull sales data = eb-22; cs-30 unsold lots = eb-23. Only in Card Sales: cs-27 time pack nights, cs-28 log eBay payouts, Blue Jays photo.
